name: VANQUISH
source:
Main character provides the best delivery service on his helicopter. He accepts all kinds of illegal requests. This time he transfers a girl to some forest for an unknown man. However, it's some woman that welcomes him on arrival. What's the meaning of this?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公驾驶直升机，提供最出色的运送服务，各种非法委托也来者不拒。这一次，一名身份不明的男人委托他把一名女孩送进某片森林，可抵达后迎接他的却是一名女子。这究竟是怎么回事？

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
